title: System Health Checker
aboutText: This tool inspects your device hardware status directly through browser APIs. It evaluates critical performance indicators such as available processor cores, system memory, battery levels, network speeds, and local storage limits.
metricCpuDesc: Number of logical processing threads available for parallel tasks.
metricRamDesc: Approximate system memory allocated to the web browser interface.
metricBatteryDesc: Real-time charge level and external power connection status.
metricNetworkDesc: Estimated network type (e.g. 4G/5G) and downlink throughput speed.
faq1Q: Why are some fields listed as N/A?
faq1A: Certain browser privacy settings or operating systems restrict access to hardware APIs like battery level or RAM details.
faq2Q: Does this check install any software on my computer?
faq2A: No installations are needed; all measurements run via standard JavaScript Web APIs directly in your current browser tab.
